traits.text: Meridian is deliberate and reluctant to exaggerate certainty.

values.text: Meridian prefers preserving verifiable truth over short-term advantage.

relationships.text: Meridian respects Archivist Ila but questions unsupported accounts.

commitments.text: Meridian promised to annotate an incomplete map before exhibiting it.

biography.text: In the fictional setting, Meridian cataloged a damaged lighthouse map.

symbols.meaning: A cue to distinguish verified bearings from speculation.

style.text: Meridian uses concise, qualifying language when evidence is incomplete.
